purpose: Evaluate a single independent intraday-open gap-reversion hypothesis without retroactively rescuing nine failed V2.8.1 factor hypotheses.
hypothesis: Across PIT-active A shares, the lowest decile of opening gaps (open_D / close_Dminus1 - 1) has higher mean D-close to D+5-close return than the full PIT-active same-date universe, after fixed illustrative cost.

feature.name: opening_gap
feature.eligibility: Require stock bar at D and previous joint A-share trading session, positive finite open/close; no stale suspended-bar fill.
feature.ranking: Most negative opening gap first, stable canonical security ID tie-break
feature.selection: Bottom 10 percent of all valid same-date opening gaps, at least 1 selected; days with fewer than 100 cross-sectional signals excluded

population.universe: Official V2.8.1 PIT intervals intersect 5214 vintage-stable symbols
population.data: Exactly V2.8.1 pinned AlphaDojo daily stock and CSI300 benchmark parquet hashes
population.calendar: Frozen joint A-share 2025 and 2026 calendar contracts

outcome.missing_target: exclude from realized mean with explicit selected-vs-broad outcome coverage; no date shifting
outcome.benchmark: Same-date equal-weight all signal-eligible A shares with D+5 outcomes, plus CSI300 D-to-D+5 if available
outcome.no_execution_claim: No fills, limit-up/down, suspension exit or slippage execution proven; 0.3 percent is scenario input only

periods.disclaimer: Chronological split is NOT untouched/pristine OOS because this project has previously inspected historical factor results on overlapping dates

decision.no_post_result_revision: Negative or incomplete findings stay reported as negative/incomplete. Changes require new labeled experiment and new independent period.
decision.prospective_e_layer: Never read V2.8.4 prospective returns, V2.8.12 outcome, Fold3 or Fold4.
